correctness.rationale: Independently constructed twelve lines of AG(2,3) in four slopes and point/line complements. Point component has 339 nonempty faces, f=(9,36,84,126,72,12); line component 1545 nonempty faces, f=(12,66,216,450,468,252,72,9). Staged Morse matches: respectively 163 and 766 pairs, one critical vertex, eleven critical 3-cells, one critical 4-cell each. Exhaustively checked 1,260 and 7,008 Hasse orientations for acyclicity. Recomputed integer critical d4=0 for BOTH. Their 3-skeleta are wedges of eleven 3-spheres, and pi3 is free on those degrees, so their 4-cells attach null-homotopically. Graph bipartition leaves exactly these two connected components. This independently validates the stated integral homotopy; novelty is a distinct question.
residual_risks: Self-contained exact finite reconstruction does not itself certify the historic original tree identity; locked Git blobs and source tree SHA guard supplied.

evidence: Oct 18 published full RESULT 'Homotopy and affine symmetry of the Hesse noncover complex', blob 774086d616dbc3d14a8c068cb7ec3e8cb0289248, states for the SAME nine points and twelve lines NC(P,L) = wedge^11 S3 vee S4 and ALSO the full 432-element affine homology character; the current point component is exactly NC(P,L). Standard Dowker duality for the nonincidence relation implies identical homotopy for the current line component. Therefore prior result plus standard duality entails the entire final claim, not just Betti numbers.
